label: Lanino & Elnina
_shapeNote: UNUSUAL SHAPE — READ THIS BEFORE WIRING IT UP. (1) `enemy` is deliberately the CONTROLLER, not a monster. obj_lanino_enemy (monstertype 61) and obj_elnina_enemy (monstertype 60) are the two visible obj_monsterparent enemies of encounter 113 (gml_GlobalScript_scr_encountersetup.gml:709 and :713), but neither contains one line of attack code — both Step events are 133 lines of ACT handling and nothing else (gml_Object_obj_lanino_enemy_Step_0.gml:15-109 and its mirror image obj_elnina_enemy_Step_0.gml:15-109). gml_Object_obj_elnina_enemy_Create_0.gml:25 does `instance_create(x, y, obj_elnina_lanino_controller);` and that controller owns the whole fight. Both the boxBlock and the turnBlock read `turns`, a CONTROLLER variable, so they must be replayed with self = an obj_elnina_lanino_controller instance or they throw. (2) There is NO `monsterattackname` anywhere in this fight — not in either enemy, not in the controller, not in obj_dbulletcontroller's type-130 branch (verified by grep over all seven files). gen_attacks.js's announcement scan therefore finds ZERO attacks no matter which object goes in `enemy`; the roster below is DECLARED, in the style of Pink's `dates`, not scanned. (3) selectorScan is not applicable either. This is not Ch1-style `if (var == N) spawn`: the dispatcher is a single unconditional `dc.type = 130` and the attack is picked by a SECOND field, `dc.special`, off a turn ladder. Scanning `turns == N` over the controller Step would hit 40+ dialogue branches, and none of the `turns == N` hits has a scr_bulletspawner call inside its window (the spawner precedes the whole ladder), so the scan would emit nothing usable and a lot of noise.
_anchorNote: All four anchor strings were grepped and each occurs EXACTLY ONCE in gml_Object_obj_elnina_lanino_controller_Step_0.gml: `if (!instance_exists(obj_growtangle))` at :1049, `if (!instance_exists(obj_moveheart))` at :1058, `if (turns < 5)` at :1159, `global.typer = 6;` at :1171. extractTurnBlock's disambiguator (a `turntimer` mention within 80 chars of the anchor) is satisfied — :1160 is `scr_turntimer(260);`. real.name: Weather Report — twin mascots, opposing bullets KISS on contact
real.evidence: gml_Object_obj_elnina_lanino_controller_Step_0.gml:1127-1134 — the ONLY dispatcher in the fight is the `with (_a)` block at :1122-1155, and its ladder assigns `dc.special = 0` for `other.turns == 0`, `== 1` and `== 2`. `turns` starts at 0 (Create_0:3) and is incremented once per enemy turn at Step_0:332, so turns 1 and 2 are the first two bullet turns of every playthrough. The value also REPEATS: Step_0:235-238, `else if (turns > 1 && ilovetv == 0 && turn2_turns < 7) turns = 0;`, resets the ladder in the menu phase every turn until the player says I LOVE TV at least once, so a player who never ACTs loops on special 0 for six turns before turn2_turns reaches 7. Turn length 260 from the ladder at Step_0:1159-1160. Behaviour lives in gml_Object_obj_elnina_mascotattack_Step_0.gml:33-34 (mascots placed at box.x +/-72, box.y-116), :131-141 (both drift with a sin sway), :138-139 and :188-195 (at siner 162 both mascots switch to their KISS sprite ms[i][1]; at siner 168 a spr_ch3_bullet_heart marker floats up and fades), :197-198 (shotrate 11 on both sides, with NO extrabulletrate term). cut.evidence: gml_Object_obj_elnina_lanino_controller_Step_0.gml:1127-1128. mechanics:
ONE FIGHT, TWO ENEMIES, ONE CONTROLLER, ONE ATTACK SHAPE.

Encounter 113 (gml_GlobalScript_scr_encountersetup.gml:702-725): obj_lanino_enemy (monstertype 61, :709) at view +480/+46 and obj_elnina_enemy (monstertype 60, :713) at +510/+180; rank1turns 7 (:719); battlemsg "* Let's hear it!! \"I LOVE TV!!!\"!" (:724). Entered from gml_Object_obj_board_event_ninfight_Step_0.gml:145. Both monsters are 8880 HP / AT 12 / DF 0 / 160 gold with sparepoint 0 and mercymax 100 (gml_GlobalScript_scr_monstersetup.gml:1782-1836), and neither object has an Other_20 spare handler, so they are not meant to be defeated at all — though the dispatcher does have a fallback for Lanino being gone. gml_Object_obj_elnina_enemy_Create_0.gml:25 spawns obj_elnina_lanino_controller, which does everything: intro, forecast HUD, turn ladder, the single dispatcher, all post-bullet dialogue, and the win. The two enemy objects contain no attack code — their Steps are pure ACT handling, and every ACT writes back into the controller.

WIN CONDITION IS NOT HP, AND IT IS RIGGED. Tenna announces it in the intro (Step_0:110-124): say "I LOVE TV" 99 times. Both monsters' ACT lists are Check / ILoveTV / ILoveTVX (scr_monstersetup.gml:1794-1807 and :1822-1835), and Susie's and Ralsei's S-Action/R-Action slots are renamed "ILoveTV" for the duration (gml_GlobalScript_scr_spellmenu_setup.gml:50-51 and :74-75, both gated on `i_ex(obj_elnina_lanino_controller)`). Each ACT bumps `ilovetv_increase`, and Step_0:189-222 ticks the counter up one frame at a time with a rising pitch. The counter is HARD-CAPPED AT 39: Step_0:210-211, `if (ilovetvlimit == true && ilovetv == 40) ilovetv = 30;` — you literally cannot win early, the display just bounces 30-39. `ilovetvlimit` is cleared only at Step_0:2115, inside the scripted ending, and :2124-2132 then sets `ilovetv_increase = 99` so the counter races to 99 by itself while obj_ilovetv balloons spawn (:2143-2156). scr_wincombat() follows at :2186. The battle is ALWAYS won on the script, at the end of turn 7, never on damage or on the counter.

THE TURN LADDER (this is the chooser). `turns` (Create_0:3 = 0) increments once per enemy turn at Step_0:332. Phase order is menu (global.myfight == 0) -> enemytalk (global.mnfight == 1) -> bullets (global.mnfight == 2), per gml_GlobalScript_scr_isphase.gml. Two regulators sit on the ladder, both in the menu phase block at Step_0:224-300:
  * :235-238 — `else if (turns > 1 && ilovetv == 0 && turn2_turns < 7) turns = 0;`. If the player has not said I LOVE TV even once, the ladder is pinned: the sequence goes 1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 2 and only breaks out when `turn2_turns` reaches 7. Special 0 repeats.
  * :230-234 (menu) and :334-335 (enemytalk) — once `ilovetv > 0 && turn2_turns > 2`, `turns` is fast-forwarded to 2 and then to 3, skipping to the choicer turn.
The resulting sequence is turns 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5 -> 6 -> 7 -> ending, i.e. specials 0, 0, 1, 2, 3, 3, 4. There is NO randomness in attack selection anywhere in this fight.

THE DISPATCHER (one site, Step_0:1078-1178). At `rtimer == 12` in the bullets phase it runs `with (_a) { dc = scr_bulletspawner(x, y, obj_dbulletcontroller); dc.type = 130; ... }`. `_a` is the raw object index 379, falling back to 946 if obj_lanino_enemy is gone (:1117-1120); against the Chapter 3 objects.tsv those are obj_lanino_enemy and obj_elnina_enemy respectively. So the spawner runs with self = Lanino, or Elnina if Lanino has been killed. Only two fields vary: `dc.special` off the turn ladder (:1127-1149) and `dc.side` off favouritism (:1151-1154). `difficulty` is never written and stays 0; `damage` comes from scr_bulletspawner as `global.monsterat[myself] * 5` = 60.

TYPE 130 IS A THIN WRAPPER. gml_Object_obj_dbulletcontroller_Step_0.gml:2614-2624 immediately creates obj_elnina_mascotattack with `attacktype = special`, `favored = side`, `type = difficulty`, calls scr_bullet_inherit, then :2626-2627 does `if (special != 4) exit;`. All five attacks are branches of gml_Object_obj_elnina_mascotattack_Step_0.gml (456 lines); the only thing the dbulletcontroller keeps for itself is the final attack's dialogue timing (:2629-2746).

FAVOURITISM (`side` / `favored`) IS PLAYER-DRIVEN. Step_0:304: `var _lanino_favored = (lastchosen == "" && sunboost > 0) || lastchosen == "lanino";`. Before the turn-3 choicer, `lastchosen` is "" and favouritism is driven purely by ACTs: saying I LOVE TV to Lanino does `sunboost++` capped at 3 (obj_lanino_enemy_Step_0.gml:32-33 and :65-66), to Elnina `sunboost--` floored at -3 (obj_elnina_enemy_Step_0.gml:32-33 and :65-66); the tie (sunboost 0) resolves to Elnina favored. After the bullets of turn 3 the game asks outright — a two-option choicer, "#Rain" vs "#Shine" (Step_0:1508-1530) — and the answer LOCKS favouritism for the rest of the fight (Step_0:1531-1590: sunboost -/+3, `lastchosen` "elnina"/"lanino", mirrored into global.flag[1017]). Both sides are reachable for every special, so the real roster is 5 attacks x 2 sides = 10 launchable variants.

THE FORECAST DECIDES BULLET SPRITES, NOT ATTACKS. Step_0:224-300 (menu phase, once per turn, guarded by `calculated_forecast` which is cleared at :330) fills `forecasts[0..2]` with `[temperature, laninoSprite, elninaSprite]` from a switch on `forecast_turn` (= `turns` BEFORE that turn's increment): 0 -> moon+snow, 1 -> sun+rain, 2 -> moon+rain, 3+ -> `choose(0,1)` between sun+snow and moon+rain, with temperatures that run away (80 + 100*(t-3) if Lanino was chosen, 40 - 30*(t-3) if Elnina was). Sprite ids are bare numbers: 783/1474/4255/1650 = spr_weather_sun / _moon / _rain / _snow. gml_Object_obj_elnina_mascotattack_Create_0.gml:11-16 reads forecasts[0] but ONLY while `turns < 7`, and Step_0:305-321 uses it to pick each side's bullet sprite: Lanino moon -> bs[4] spr_ch3_bullet_moon, Lanino sun -> bs[3] spr_ch3_bullet_sun, Elnina rain -> bs[5] spr_ch3_bullet_raindrop, Elnina snow -> bs[1] spr_ch3_bullet_ice. On turn 7 the forecast is skipped and the defaults apply (`bs[3 - i*2]`: Lanino sun, Elnina ice). The enemytalk dialogue that names the weather ("... Moon." / "... Drop." / "EXTRA DEXTRA Sun!" / "TRUEST Crystal!", Step_0:646-1020) is matched to the forecast, and it also writes `lanino_attack` / `elnina_attack` to 68/69/70/71 — which nothing reads (see the cut list).

BULLET-VS-BULLET IS THE FIGHT'S IDENTITY. gml_Object_obj_regularbullet_elnina_Step_0.gml:31-81 does a manual `collision_rectangle(..., object_index, true, true)` against its own object every step. Same sprite -> pass through (:35-36). spr_lanino_fire -> pass through (:38-39). While `obj_elnina_lanino_controller.turns <= 2` a Lanino bullet meeting an Elnina bullet turns BOTH into pink spr_ch3_bullet_heart with snd_coaster_kiss (:44-54) — the couple is in love. From turn 3 on, the same collision annihilates both with snd_bump and a grey spr_ball_small shrink marker (:56-81) — the couple is fighting. Separately, obj_elnina_mascotattack counts its own shots and turns every `firebulletcount`-th bullet into a red 2x spr_lanino_fire (Create_0:26 sets firebulletcount to 2000, Step_0:339-348 applies it); in the live fight it is never lowered, so it effectively never fires — only the cut rematch drops it to 20 or 12 at high mercy (Step_0:328-335, gated on `i_ex(obj_lanino_rematch_enemy)`).

RETRIES MAKE IT EASIER. gml_Object_obj_elnina_lanino_controller_Create_0.gml:58-61 increments the persistent global.elninalosscount on every entry after the first; gml_Object_obj_elnina_mascotattack_Create_0.gml:9 copies it into `extrabulletrate`, which is ADDED to shotrate — and shotrate is the number of frames BETWEEN shots, so a higher loss count means FEWER bullets. It applies to specials 2, 3 and 4 only; specials 0 and 1 pin shotrate to a flat 11.

NO SOUL MODE, NO MINIGAME. scr_moveheart() at Step_0:1058-1059 is the plain red soul. obj_growtangle is created with no maxxscale/maxyscale override, so it is the default 2x2 box (obj_growtangle_Create_0.gml:13-14); only its Y position changes, and only on turn 7. There is no green/purple/yellow mode, no obj_purplecontrols, no ACT minigame, no HP gate and no phase variable. Bullet damage is flat 60 with grazepoints 2 (obj_regularbullet_elnina_Create_0.gml:7-8), and its Other_15 hard-overwrites `target = 4` at line 1 before damaging — a real scr_damage mode (gml_GlobalScript_scr_damage.gml:47-69) that re-rolls the target up to three times, biasing it AWAY from any party member below half the party HP average and away from Kris below 35%.

SCRIPTED FURNITURE. The controller creates obj_actor_tenna in its Create (:44-48) and drives him through the intro and the ending; the intro has two variants, the normal one and a shorter `obj_board_event_ninfight.retry == 1` version (Step_0:1-81 vs :82-167). The controller's Draw_0 owns two HUD layers: the two-digit I LOVE TV counter in spr_tv_counter_numbers (:9-31) and the three-pane weather forecast (:38-126, spr_glass_pane + spr_weather_* + a temperature rendered in Fahrenheit or Celsius depending on `use_celsius = string_lower(os_get_region()) != "us"`, Create_0:13). Draw_0:128-135 destroys the controller and its Tenna when global.fighting hits 0.

OTHER FIGHTS THAT REUSE THESE OBJECTS (do not confuse them with this roster). ROUXLS KAARD: obj_lanino_enemy_rouxls and obj_elnina_enemy_rouxls are separate objects used as backup dancers, driven from obj_dbulletcontroller's type-73 laser-pointer branch (:1256, :1262, :1321, :1324, :1348, :1351) and from obj_room_teevie_chef; their attacks belong to obj_rouxls_ch3_enemy_Step_0.gml:2894-2942 (types 74, 72, 73, 73.1, 69, 71).
